title: Lemon-Sage and Smoked Paprika Poultry Rub
description: A fine, salt-free sage blend seasons chicken thighs or turkey cutlets as they cook in broth.

ingredients.name: food-grade dried lemon peel
ingredients.note: Use finely granulated yellow peel without white pith.

steps.title: Grind the peel and herbs
steps.text: Crush {lemon}, {sage}, {thyme} and {parsley} in the mortar for about 1 minute until fine.

steps.title: Sift away tough pieces
steps.text: Pass the ground mixture through a fine sieve into a small bowl, regrinding or discarding any stiff fragments.

steps.title: Finish the blend
steps.text: Stir in {paprika} and {garlic} until evenly dispersed.

steps.title: Season a moist cook
steps.text: Use about a teaspoon per serving. Whisk the blend into broth before poaching or covered braising so the herbs hydrate. It also seasons the gravy served with the poultry.

notes: Make ahead: Store dry in a sealed spice jar for up to 2 months. Portion with a clean spoon before handling raw poultry. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The dry herbs keep well in the cupboard, while freezer moisture can make them clump. Fridge reheat: Use directly without heating. If the blend was refrigerated, let it warm in its closed jar before opening. Freezer reheat: If already frozen, thaw in the sealed jar to keep condensation off the herbs. It needs no reheating. Option A uses dried lemon peel and smoked paprika. For gentler Option B, replace the peel with extra parsley and choose sweet unsmoked paprika. Estimated nutrition per serving of the prepared condiment (1/2 of recipe): 5 kcal, 0.2 g protein, 1.0 g total carbohydrate, 0.1 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 1 mg sodium.
